mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase risk of bradycardia and cardiac arrhythmias, potentially exacerbating ivabradine's heart rate-lowering effects and electrolyte-dependent cardiac conduction abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; consider potassium-sparing diuretic or supplementation; assess heart rate and cardiac rhythm; adjust ivabradine dose if excessive bradycardia develops.
